pages.title: Drillfall
pages.creator: Varkyn
pages.description:
Steer an automatically descending drill in Drillfall, a mining arcade game where fuel limits how far each attempt can go. Move sideways to reach ore deposits, set off dynamite to uncover gem-filled craters, and keep digging toward the planet's core. Ore combinations charge Overdrive, while selectable boosts change what your drill can do during a run.

Your earnings go toward upgrades on the results screen, giving each descent a role in your progress. The route spans seven zones and includes four Drill Guardians, with the core waiting 8,000 meters underground. Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys to steer; the drill handles the downward movement itself.

pages.title: Magic Slide
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Magic Slide is a block puzzle built around horizontal movement and a steadily rising board. Drag blocks sideways to complete full rows and clear space. Every move brings fresh blocks up from below, so a useful opening can disappear if you shift pieces without planning ahead.

Keep the stack below the top of the board while building your score. Clearing blocks also fills a pot-shaped gauge that reveals diamonds, adding another goal to the task of keeping room for the next row.

pages.title: 12-in-1 Solitaire
pages.creator: Playades International LLC
pages.description:
12-in-1 Solitaire brings twelve card-game variations into one collection, including Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Golf, and Pyramid. Choose a version and consult its help pages for the layout, permitted moves, and winning condition. The rules change with your selection: some games involve building foundation piles, while Pyramid asks you to remove exposed cards in pairs totaling thirteen.

Move cards according to the selected game's rules and work through the deal. Having several versions together lets you switch between different arrangements and objectives without treating every solitaire layout as the same puzzle.

pages.title: One Line Drawing
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description:
One Line Drawing brings several drawing challenges into one collection. Trace single-line patterns and tackle pictures that need a missing part drawn in, using the pointer to create the line the puzzle requires. The task changes with the selected activity, from planning a route through a pattern to recognizing what an incomplete picture needs.

Examine the puzzle before drawing, then use your line to solve the current task. The collection pairs straightforward drawing interactions with problems that ask you to think about the shape or detail you should add.

pages.title: Epic Racing - Descent on Cars
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
Epic Racing - Descent on Cars sends you into car races where reaching the finish first means surviving heavy collisions along the way. Drive through the competition as vehicles crash and their bodywork bends from the impacts. The race continues amid the wreckage, keeping the finish line as your main objective.

Use W and S for forward and reverse movement, with A and D to steer. Balancing your route with the surrounding cars matters when a collision can leave twisted metal between you and the lead.

pages.title: What's In My Bag?
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description:
What's In My Bag? combines a fashion makeover with a reveal of the items carried inside a chosen bag. Put together an outfit, select makeup, and choose a bag to complete the look. Then explore its contents, from accessories to props that give the finished style its own theme.

Use the selection menus to experiment with the available clothes, cosmetics, and bags. The bag's contents are part of the presentation, giving you something to discover after styling the character.

pages.title: Car Paint
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Car Paint turns a small road grid into a color-matching puzzle. Slide colored cars across a three-by-three board so their paint trails reproduce the reference picture above it. A car keeps moving until it reaches an edge or another vehicle, so positioning the cars is as important as choosing a direction.

Swipe a selected car to send it along the grid, then compare the painted cells with the target. You need to fill the board with the correct pattern to complete the puzzle and open the next challenge. The game contains thirty layouts that use the same compact board in different ways.

pages.title: Horror Hotel: Scary Room
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Run a business built around frightening its customers in Horror Hotel: Scary Room. Develop rooms of fear, add creepy decorations and equipment, and hire actors to deliver the scares. Serving visitors earns the money needed to expand the attraction and improve what each room offers.

The work also includes cleaning rooms and repairing equipment. Keeping the attraction in good condition supports customer satisfaction while you add more rooms and recruit assistants. Your task combines the spectacle of a haunted venue with the practical work of operating it: bring customers in, maintain the rooms, and invest the profits in the next improvement.

pages.title: Starry Style Dorama of Dream
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Starry Style Dorama of Dream casts you as the stylist for an actress and an actor starting their careers in Korean television dramas. Choose their clothing, hairstyles, and accessories to create a separate look for each performer. Mix the available pieces to shape how the pair will appear on screen.

Click or tap the wardrobe options to make your selections. Once the styling is finished, you can save the resulting looks as PNG images, keeping a copy of the outfits you created for the two actors.

pages.title: Merge Run Battle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description:
Merge Run Battle combines a sideways-controlled runner with merging and combat. Swipe horizontally to guide your character through the running sections, then use hero combinations and upgrades to develop a stronger fighting force. The action alternates between controlling your route and improving the characters involved in battle.

Your progress depends on both parts of that loop: guide the run, work with the merging system, and put your upgraded heroes into the next fight.

pages.title: Cannon Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Cannon Shooter has you launch groups of heroes from a cannon to confront approaching enemies. Click or tap to send more characters into the fight, using numbered gates to increase the force you produce. The gates make the route of your shots part of the challenge as you try to build a larger group.

Keep firing and use the opportunities to generate additional heroes while dealing with the opposing forces. The action revolves around producing fighters through the cannon and putting those numbers to use in battle.

pages.title: Happy Brothers
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Help two festive siblings leave their decorated home in Happy Brothers. Search for the key and the yellow diamond, gather the gift boxes, and bring together the items needed to activate the exit portal. The Christmas outfits and New Year setting frame an escape built around collecting what the house is hiding.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use the available double jump while exploring. Reaching the portal is only part of the task: you also need to collect the required items before the brothers can get outside.

pages.title: Space Shift
pages.creator: Mateq
pages.description:
Space Shift is an obstacle-avoidance game in which your spacecraft travels automatically. Slow its movement to stay clear of meteorites and missiles, keeping the journey going for as long as possible. Different galaxies change the scenery and the obstacles you encounter, with an alien ship waiting far enough along the route.

Press Space to slow down on a keyboard. Touch controls divide the screen into a slowing area on the left and a secondary-ability area on the right. Your main task is to adjust the ship's pace so it passes through danger without a collision.

pages.title: Cat Life Merge Money
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
In Cat Life Merge Money, a stray cat earns its next meal by asking passing humans for cash. Click or tap the cat to keep it begging, then merge the money it receives into more valuable amounts. Use the resulting funds to buy food and improve the cat's circumstances.

The cat stops making an effort if you leave it idle, so continued interaction drives the earning loop. Begging supplies the money, merging increases its value, and spending it helps your street cat move toward a more comfortable life.

pages.title: Banana Farm
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Banana Farm puts a cat entrepreneur in charge of a farm and supermarket. Grow bananas and other produce, keep the market running, and serve the cat customers lining up to shop. Farming supplies what the business sells, tying the fields to the work of managing the store.

Recruit cat workers to help the operation run more efficiently as you develop it. Your attention moves between producing goods, assisting customers, and organizing the workforce, with each part supporting the same growing business.

pages.title: Riot Village
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Riot Village is a shooting game with automatic movement and enemies controlled by the computer. Your character handles the travel, leaving you to aim, fire, and change weapons as threats appear. Opponents carry different weapons, making your equipment choices part of each encounter.

Between the ten levels, visit the market to choose from six weapons. You can carry up to four at a time and switch between them during play. Build an inventory that gives you useful alternatives, then concentrate on shooting accurately while the character moves through the village.

pages.title: Cartoon Moto Stunt
pages.creator: kaachingo
pages.description:
Cartoon Moto Stunt combines motorcycle challenges with a garage of bikes to buy and upgrade. Ride through twenty-four levels, using timing and control to tackle the stunts presented by each course. Four motorcycles are available, and each has four visual designs to choose from.

Earn coins while playing and put them toward another bike or improvements to your current one. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the motorcycle, and press Shift for nitro. Progress involves both completing the riding challenges and deciding how to spend your earnings in the garage.

pages.title: Jab Jab Boxing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Your keyboard supplies the punches in Jab Jab Boxing. Type the motivational words shown during a bout to send out jabs and combinations. The action takes place in a boxing ring, but your ability to enter the text drives the fight.

The game draws on more than two hundred motivational quotes and phrases, giving you different text to work through as you box. Keep your attention on the words while the fighters respond to your typing, turning the bout into a test of keyboard speed.

pages.title: Memory Match Magic
pages.creator: Indie developer
pages.description:
Memory Match Magic asks you to uncover matching pairs in a board of face-down cards. Flip cards, remember the pictures you reveal, and use that information to find their partners. Each correct pair contributes to clearing the board's hidden images.

The cards and animations have a magical theme, while the main task remains remembering where each picture appeared. Click or tap your selections and build up a picture of the board as you work toward finding every pair.

pages.title: Love In Style
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description:
Love In Style follows a Valentine's Day wardrobe change from baking preparations to a date. Start by choosing what the character will wear in the kitchen while she gets ready to make a sweet gift. Then select a different outfit for the romantic outing.

Use the mouse to explore the clothing choices and create a look for each occasion. The two settings give the styling a sequence: first a kitchen outfit, then a finished date look for the date ahead.

pages.title: Xmas Bubble Frenzy
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Clear the required number of bubbles in each level of Xmas Bubble Frenzy while keeping them away from the border. The festive setting surrounds a score challenge in which special bubbles offer extra points. Completing a level's collection target lets you continue to the next.

Use the mouse or touchpad to interact with the bubbles, watch their position relative to the boundary, and look for the special ones as you work toward the required total.

pages.title: Congested Car Parking
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Congested Car Parking gives you twenty parking challenges, each with a direction arrow to guide you to the destination. Drive toward the indicated space, line the car up, and park it facing the required way to complete the level. Finding the spot and positioning the vehicle are both part of the task.

Use the arrow keys to drive and watch the route indicator while approaching your space. Work through all twenty locations by adjusting the car's direction before settling into the final parking position.

pages.title: Diy Vehicle Climber 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Diy Vehicle Climber 3D combines vehicle assembly with an obstacle course. Fit parts to your vehicle, then use the result to get past the barriers between you and the end of the route. The task is to put the components to work on the course rather than simply choose a finished car.

Tap to interact with the game and guide your assembled vehicle through each challenge. Three background options let you change the playing environment as you continue building and climbing toward the finish.

pages.title: Hidden Objects: Brain Teaser
pages.creator: CASUAL AZUR GAMES
pages.description:
Hidden Objects: Brain Teaser turns each illustrated location into a search for missing items. Check the objects shown along the bottom of the screen, examine the scene, and select the matching things hidden among its details. Finding everything requested completes the location's search challenge.

The target list keeps your attention on specific objects rather than every item in the picture. Compare their appearance with what you can see in the scene and work through the list as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Oceania
pages.creator: Draugiem, SIA
pages.description:
Oceania begins with your arrival on an unfamiliar island and the task of making room for a farm. Clear back the jungle, establish a household, and gradually turn more of the island into usable farming space. The setting gives your expansion a clear direction: start at the shore and reclaim ground from the wilderness.

The farming system also includes helping friends with their work. You can perform a limited number of helping actions for each friend per day, with most of that assistance using no energy. Develop your own island while contributing to neighboring farms.

pages.title: Squid Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Squid Collection is a timed matching puzzle where you draw a path through neighboring identical items. Start on an item, connect at least three of the same kind, and release to collect the chain. Connections can run across, up and down, or diagonally, giving you several directions to explore.

Each level asks for particular squid-themed items before the timer expires. Longer chains can provide bonuses, including additional time for a connection of more than seven items. Check the requested items before starting a chain so your matches help complete the level's targets.

pages.title: Sniper Shot: Bullet Time
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description:
Sniper Shot: Bullet Time centers on lining up rifle shots and following their impact through a bullet camera. Aim at enemy targets, fire, and watch the projectile's path into the body. Changing your shooting position and the part of the target you hit produces different views of the shot.

Use WASD to move, the right mouse button to aim, and the left mouse button to fire. The mouse wheel adjusts zoom, while Space lets you jump. The combination of positioning, scoped aiming, and the close-up impact sequence makes each attack more than a quick trigger press.

pages.title: Bounce challenge Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Bounce challenge Colors Game keeps you moving between walls while spikes threaten the top and bottom of the screen. Make repeated jumps to control your position and stay clear of the hazards. You can jump as often as needed, but touching a spike ends the attempt.

Watch the vertical space available as you cross from one side to the other. Every jump changes how much room remains between you and the dangerous edges.

pages.title: Princess Prom Night
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description:
Princess Prom Night lets you style high school graduates for their end-of-school celebration. Browse dresses, other outfit choices, and hairstyles to prepare the girls for prom. The focus is on combining the available fashion items into finished party looks.

Tap the options to try different clothing and hair combinations. Each selection changes the appearance you are creating, giving you room to experiment with a modern or more formal style for the graduation party.

pages.title: Triple Digits
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description:
Triple Digits is a number-merging puzzle in which groups of three or more equal values become a single tile worth twice as much. Combine twos into a four, then use matching fours to make an eight as you build larger numbers on the board.

Patterned tiles add a second objective to the merging. Making a match on one doubles the points for that move, and clearing all the patterned tiles doubles your score again. Plan your combinations around both the numbers and those marked spaces. The game ends when the board has neither free spaces nor patterned tiles remaining, so preserving useful room is part of building a high score.

pages.title: Loot Heroes 2
pages.creator: Vitaly
pages.description:
Loot Heroes 2 sends you through purgatory on another assignment from the Darkness Lord. Defeat ten rebellious Lords of Hell while fighting your way through an action RPG built around a roster of unlockable characters. Twenty heroes offer different abilities, and switching characters lets you make use of their individual skills.

Click the left mouse button to move and attack. Use the right mouse button or Space to activate a skill during combat. Your choice of hero affects the ability available for the next encounter as you work toward completing the Darkness Lord's task.

pages.title: Craftsman Coloring Pages
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Craftsman Coloring Pages offers eighteen pictures to color with a palette of fifteen shades. Pick a drawing, choose your colors, and apply them to the image using the mouse or touch controls. You decide how the characters will look as the picture fills with your choices.

The game also lets you save a colored image. Finish the picture you selected, keep a copy of the result, or move on to another drawing from the collection.

pages.title: Exact Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Exact Jump is a timing challenge built around getting a ball inside a moving target. Tap to make the ball jump, aiming to land precisely within the marked area. After a successful hit, the target moves to a new position and you must judge the next jump again.

You have room for three mistakes before the game ends. Keep adapting to the target's changing location and try to string together as many accurate jumps as possible within that allowance.

pages.title: Color Destroyer
pages.creator: Human Soft, Inc
pages.description:
Clear every shape in Color Destroyer while staying within the level's click allowance. Clicking removes a shape, and connected shapes sharing its color can disappear together. The puzzle is to arrange useful connections before spending too many moves.

Different markings determine how pieces behave. Solid shapes respond to gravity, striped shapes stay fixed in place, and arrow-marked shapes fall in the direction they show. Removing one piece can therefore change which shapes meet next. Think through those movements before clicking so a single action can clear a larger connected group. Thirty prepared scenes introduce increasingly demanding arrangements to solve with a limited number of clicks.

pages.title: PRINCESS TATTOO SALON
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description:
PRINCESS TATTOO SALON lets you create colorful tattoo designs on a character's body. Work with the available artwork and colors to decorate areas such as the arms and back. Use the mouse to click and drag the objects involved in each design.

The creative task is choosing how the tattoo should look and combining colors within it. Follow the salon's interactions to turn the selected design into a finished piece of body art.

pages.title: Pop It Fidget
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description:
Pop It Fidget gives you a selection of virtual pop-it toys to press. Click or tap each circular bubble until you have pushed every one on the toy. Designs include a unicorn, animals, fruit, and an Among Us-style shape.

Work across the circles in any sequence that helps you keep track of the remaining bubbles. The objective is to finish popping the current toy before moving on to explore another design.

pages.title: Drunken Wrestle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Drunken Wrestle turns a wrestling match into a struggle to keep your head off the floor. Move your wobbling fighter so the opponent's head hits the ground first, while protecting your own. Different arenas and conditions change the way the pair tumble and collide.

Play in the one-player mode or share the match with a second player. Player one uses W, and player two uses the up arrow key. The first fighter to earn five points wins, making each successful head-first takedown a step toward the match result.

pages.title: Among Them Puzzles
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Among Them Puzzles contains twelve timed picture puzzles featuring crewmates and impostors from Among Us. Rebuild each image by dragging pieces into different positions until the scene is correctly arranged. Completing the current picture lets you continue to the next puzzle.

The time limit makes recognizing the image and choosing the right positions part of the challenge. Look at the details on each piece, move it where it belongs, and finish the arrangement before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Princess Cyberpunk 2200
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Princess Cyberpunk 2200 gives four characters a futuristic wardrobe makeover. Style Jacqueline, Little Mermaid, Eliza, and Harlequin with cyberpunk outfits, bold hair colors, and bright makeup. Their clothing and hairstyles form the look of princesses living in a world of advanced technology.

Click or tap the available options to change each character's appearance. Combine the fashion pieces with a hairstyle and cosmetics that work together, creating a separate future-inspired look for every member of the group.

pages.title: Troll Battle Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Search illustrated battle scenes for concealed stars in Troll Battle Hidden. There are ten stars to find in each of the six levels, and you must uncover them before the time limit expires. Click or tap a star when you spot its outline in the picture.

Repeated incorrect selections remove five seconds from the remaining time. Scan the scene carefully and check the details before clicking so you can complete the star count without using up the clock on guesses.

pages.title: Firefighters Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Firefighters Match 3 asks you to line up matching blocks in groups of at least three. Make combinations of the same color to raise your score while watching the gauge on the left side of the screen. Letting that scale fall too low ends the game.

Use the mouse or touch controls to work through the board and keep making useful matches. Your attention has to move between finding another combination and monitoring the gauge that determines how long you can continue.

pages.title: Venom Hero Street Fighting Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description:
Venom Hero Street Fighting Game is a 3D brawler in which you fight groups of superhero enemies and survive their attacks. Each stage gives you enemies to defeat before you can proceed, so staying alive and meeting the combat objective go together.

Use the arrow keys to move and Space to jump. Z and X perform attacks, while C defends against incoming blows. Combine movement, offense, and defense as successive enemy groups enter the fight, clearing the required opponents to advance through the stages.

pages.title: Hungry Chameleon
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description:
Hungry Chameleon puts flies on both sides of a hungry reptile and asks you to keep it fed. Select the correct side to catch each fly, earning points as the chameleon changes color to match what it has eaten. A time bar at the top keeps pressure on your decisions.

The pace increases as you continue, leaving less time to react to the next insect. Missing a fly ends the game, so watch the left and right sides closely while keeping an eye on the shrinking time allowance.

pages.title: Jet Ski Fun Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Jet Ski Fun Hidden hides stars inside pictures of jet skis. Examine each scene and click or tap the ten concealed stars before the timer reaches zero. The six levels ask you to complete the search in different images, with a found-star counter showing your progress.

Look closely at the outlines and small details throughout the picture. Rapid repeated clicking can cost time, so searching for a recognizable star is more useful than tapping randomly across the scene.

pages.title: Classic Old And New Cars Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Classic Old And New Cars Hidden is a timed search through car illustrations, with ten stars concealed in every scene. Find their shapes among the vehicles and background details, then click or tap each one to add it to the completed count. All ten are needed to finish the current picture.

Work through six levels before their individual timers expire. The game penalizes repeated rapid clicking by taking time away, so inspect the image carefully and select the stars you can actually identify.

pages.title: Banana Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Banana Cake is a guided cooking game that takes you from ingredients to a decorated dessert. Follow the kitchen prompts to prepare the banana mixture and cake batter, work with the mixing tools, and bake the cake in the oven. The recipe continues with preparing and spreading a creamy frosting.

Use the indicated ingredients and utensils in sequence rather than skipping straight to the finished cake. Mixing, baking, and decorating form separate parts of the process, giving you hands-on tasks as the dessert comes together.

pages.title: Food Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Food Trucks Jigsaw gives you twelve food-truck pictures to rebuild as jigsaw puzzles. Choose an image, then select a difficulty that determines how many pieces it is divided into. Easy uses twenty-five pieces, medium uses forty-nine, and hard uses one hundred.

Use the mouse or touch controls to assemble the selected picture. The same image can become a shorter puzzle or a more detailed arrangement depending on the mode, letting you choose the amount of piece-matching work before starting.

pages.title: Battleship
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description:
Battleship is a naval grid game against a computer-controlled fleet. Before the battle, drag your ships into position, rotate them to fit your layout, or use the shuffle option to create another arrangement. Start the war when your fleet is ready.

On your turn, select a square in the enemy's waters to fire. The board records hits and misses, helping you narrow down where the remaining ships may be. Your opponent attacks your own fleet between turns. Sink every enemy vessel before all of yours are destroyed to win the battle.

pages.title: Basketball Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description:
Basketball Kissing follows a player celebrating a win with his cheerleader girlfriend. Help the pair kiss while keeping watch on a photographer and another basketball player nearby. Their presence turns the celebration into a task of choosing moments when the couple will not be noticed.

Use the mouse or touch controls to interact and keep checking the onlookers. The objective is to let the couple enjoy their kiss without attracting attention from the people sharing the court.

pages.title: Nail Art Fashion Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Nail Art Fashion Salon lets you create manicure and pedicure designs with a range of decorative choices. Select colors and brushes, apply patterns or stickers, and add details such as rhinestones. Rings and tattoos give you more ways to style the finished hands and feet.

Use the mouse to explore the salon's tools and combine its decorations. A design can focus on a particular color or mix several different accents, with the result depending on the polish, patterns, and accessories you select.

pages.title: LA Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
LA Car Parking challenges you to guide a car into highlighted parking zones. Follow the directional arrows through each layout, then position the vehicle so all four wheels sit inside the destination. Nearby vehicles make the approach more demanding than simply driving straight toward the marker.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer, accelerate, and brake. Line up the car before making the final approach, and watch how its wheels fit within the marked area. The level ends when the entire vehicle is correctly parked.

pages.title: Monster Truck Freestyle 2020
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description:
Monster Truck Freestyle 2020 gives a large truck a series of driving missions with different objectives. Push a ball into a goal, squeeze through gaps, tackle climbs, and steer through zigzag routes. Each task asks for a different use of the truck's movement rather than the same race repeated.

Drive with the arrow keys and press Space to brake. Adjust your speed and turning to suit the current mission, whether you need to line up a ball, negotiate a narrow passage, or work your way over uneven ground.

pages.title: Flying Car Real Driving
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description:
Flying Car Real Driving combines road driving with flight in the same vehicle. Take control of a car that can travel along the ground and fly through the air, changing how you navigate once it enters flying mode.

Use WASD for movement. In flight, S sends the car upward, W lowers it, and A and D control left and right movement. The change in controls makes managing altitude part of the driving task as you move between traveling on the road and piloting the car in the air.

pages.title: Hover Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Hover Racer is an antigravity racing game with a choice of hoverships, vehicle upgrades, and mounted weapons. Race across three maps and earn rewards by completing levels, then use the available improvements to develop your craft. Steering and shooting are both part of controlling the ship on the track.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive the hovership and Left Shift to fire. Press Esc to pause. Your selected craft and its upgrades carry the vehicle side of the challenge, while each map gives you another course to race through.

pages.title: TrollFace Quest: Horror 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
TrollFace Quest: Horror 1 turns familiar horror scenes into short puzzles with prank endings. Examine each setup and click the objects or characters to work out the interaction that resolves it. The situations parody moments from horror films, television, and games, using unexpected reactions as the puzzle's payoff.

Look closely at what each scene offers and try the interactions that fit its strange logic. Progress comes from finding the solution to the current joke, with the next horror-inspired scene bringing a different setup to decipher.

pages.title: Water Surfer Bus
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Water Surfer Bus gives you bus-driving courses with a watery setting and marked checkpoints. Choose a bus model, take it onto the route, and steer through the checkpoints needed for the current level. The game offers multiple courses and buses to use.

Control the vehicle with WASD and press Escape to pause. Watch the route as you approach each checkpoint, adjusting your steering to keep the bus moving through the course and toward completion of the level.

pages.title: Pregnant Princess Laundry Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Pregnant Princess Laundry Day follows a full clothes-washing routine with a princess who needs help preparing clean outfits. Sort the white laundry away from the colored clothes, load the washing machine, and add detergent and fabric softener before starting the wash.

The work continues after the machine finishes. Let the clothes air-dry, then iron them so they are ready for the wardrobe. Tap through the tasks in sequence, taking the laundry from a mixed pile to clean, pressed clothing.

pages.title: Minigolf Master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Minigolf Master challenges you to putt through obstacle-filled courses using as few strokes as possible. Judge each shot around the course layout and aim to finish at par or better. Reaching par earns two stars, while beating it earns three.

Completing courses opens more levels, environments, and the medium and hard difficulties. The controls also change with the difficulty setting, so progressing introduces a different way to manage your shots as well as new course layouts. Work toward lower stroke counts while learning how the ball responds to each obstacle.

pages.title: Ninja Hero Runner
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Ninja Hero Runner sends a ninja through a dungeon survival challenge. Keep going for as long as possible, collecting coins while avoiding the obstacles in the route. Your task is to balance gathering those coins with keeping the run alive.

Watch the path for the next hazard before committing to a coin. The longer you survive, the more opportunities you have to collect, but the central goal remains getting the ninja through the dungeon without running into danger.

pages.title: Brain Teasers Avoid Crash
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Brain Teasers Avoid Crash puts you in charge of the traffic lights at a dangerous intersection. Change the signals to manage when cars move and keep their routes from crossing at the wrong moment. Every decision affects the flow through the junction.

Work through the levels while aiming for a three-star result and a strong score. Watch approaching vehicles before changing a light so one stream has room to pass without a collision. Keeping the intersection running safely is the task that connects each traffic-control challenge.

pages.title: Ice Jump
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Ice Jump puts an ice cube in a sequence of glasses and asks you to keep it moving from one to the next. Choose the moment to jump so the cube lands in another glass instead of falling between them. Each successful transfer sets up the next leap.

The game also presents tasks involving jumps, crystals, and particular colored cups. Pay attention to the current objective while judging the gap ahead, balancing progress through the glasses with the task you are trying to complete.

pages.title: Lamborghini Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Lamborghini Coloring Book gives you six car drawings and a palette of twenty-four colors. Select a picture, choose a shade, and draw onto the car with the coloring pen. Adjustable stroke width helps you move between covering larger sections and working on smaller details.

Use the available colors to create your own version of each Lamborghini illustration. The game includes options for saving and printing the finished picture, so you can keep the result after coloring or start another design from the collection.

pages.title: Airport Manager Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Airport Manager Simulator puts you to work on passenger service tasks around a flight. Prepare and serve food on the plane, help keep travelers happy, and clean the cabin after landing. The activities focus on looking after people and maintaining the aircraft's interior during the travel routine.

Use the mouse to interact with the items required for each job. Move through the service and cleaning activities, handling the needs of the passengers as well as the condition of the cabin.

pages.title: Save Rocket
pages.creator: T
pages.description:
Save Rocket is a survival arcade game where you move a rocket sideways to avoid incoming barriers. Steer through the available openings and keep clear of obstacles as the scrolling playfield brings new hazards into view. A collision ends the attempt.

Use the left and right arrow keys, or the onscreen left and right controls, to change position. Watch the approaching gaps and adjust your route while trying to keep the rocket alive and increase your score.

pages.title: Space Galaxcolory
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Space Galaxcolory is a scrolling space shooter built around defending your craft from approaching enemies. Fire at hostile targets and move clear of attacks and contact hazards as the enemy formations arrive. The challenge combines shooting with finding room to survive among the incoming threats.

pages.title: Ice Queen Bathroom Deco
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ice Queen Bathroom Deco takes a neglected bathroom through cleaning and a new interior design. Begin by putting discarded paper in the bin, sweeping away cobwebs, and mopping the wet floor. Follow the highlighted tools to work through the room's cleaning tasks before turning to the decoration.

Then choose different floors, walls, mirrors, carpets, and furnishings to change the bathroom's appearance. Cycle through the available options for each part of the room and combine them into a finished design. The two stages connect practical cleanup with choosing how the refreshed bathroom will look.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Dotted Girl Coloring Book presents drawings from a superhero's world for you to color. Browse the pages, select a picture, and choose the colors you want to add to its characters and details. Glitter provides another way to decorate the finished image.

Tap the available choices to work on one drawing, then explore the other pages in the book. You can experiment with different color combinations while turning the collection's outlines into your own versions of Dotted Girl's adventures.

pages.title: LA REX
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take control of a destructive tyrannosaur in LA REX. Move through the levels, attack the humans in your path, and create enough havoc to clear each stage. Eating people is part of the dinosaur's rampage as you work through the game's level objectives.

pages.title: School Girls Summer Camp!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
School Girls Summer Camp! follows Princess Ellie and her two daughters as they prepare for a summer trip. Help put together the girls' looks before they leave for camp, choosing from the clothing and hairstyle options in the wardrobe.

Try combinations of tops, dresses, and other outfit pieces to get each daughter ready for the outing. The preparation gives the fashion choices a setting: create the looks the two girls will wear as they head away for their summer holiday.

pages.title: Angela Toddler Feed
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Angela Toddler Feed turns breakfast into a balancing act between preparing food and keeping Ginger happy. Help Angela warm the milk and mix it with cereal, then feed the kitten while responding when he becomes upset. His mood can interrupt what would otherwise be a simple meal.

Tap the items needed during the routine and keep your attention on Ginger while he eats. The cereal should not be left to go cold, so caring for the kitten and continuing breakfast need to happen together.

pages.title: Princess Modern Fashionista
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description:
Princess Modern Fashionista follows a princess through a complete wardrobe refresh. Start by clearing out the old clothes and packing them away, then visit the shop to choose new fashion pieces. The shopping trip supplies the outfits you will try on afterward.

Back at home, combine the purchases and choose the look you want her to wear. The sequence links sorting, shopping, and dressing up, letting you take part in the preparation as well as the final fashion choices.

pages.title: Bubble Rain
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Bubble Rain is a bubble-popping score game with special bubbles and a dangerous bomb type. Pop ordinary bubbles to collect points and use the special ones to gain powers. Bomb bubbles cost a life when touched, so choosing what to pop matters as much as reacting quickly.

Use the game's one-touch interaction to target the useful bubbles while leaving the bombs alone. Keep building your score without spending lives on the hazards mixed into the rain.
